entities.summary:
Djefaihapi was an ancient Egyptian official during the reign of pharaoh Senusret I of the 12th Dynasty (c. 1963–1920 BCE).


He held significant administrative positions, including that of vizier (chief minister), which underscored his importance in the pharaoh's inner circle.


As a prominent figure in the 12th Dynasty, Djefaihapi's influence extended beyond Egypt's borders, with records of his name appearing in various forms across the ancient Near East.


Despite the passing of millennia, Djefaihapi's legacy remains a testament to the enduring power of ancient Egyptian administration and diplomacy.
